title: nutrient-rich velvety slovakian courgettes gratin
description: a funky and velvety slovakian dish featuring courgettes, caramelized to perfection in a low-carb-friendly individual mini-cocotte. perfect as a hangover cure or a nutritious meal any time of the day.
instructions: slice the courgettes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
in a large skillet, caramelize the onion and garlic over medium heat until golden brown.
in a separate pan, melt the butter and add the flour to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
slowly add the heavy cream, whisking continuously, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
add the grated grana padano and whisk until melted.
add the eggs, salt, and black pepper to the cream mixture and whisk until well combined.
in a greased mini-cocotte, create a layer of courgettes, followed by a layer of the cream mixture, and repeat until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cream on top.
cover the mini-cocotte with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
